ok-conservation-district-directors.summary: Conservation District cards name your district and give its office, telephone and e-mail. They name the directors of only the five districts that list their board on their own website, because the state's directory names no one.
ok-conservation-district-directors.why: Three directors are elected and two appointed, and the Oklahoma Conservation Commission issues each one's certificate. It publishes each district's office but not who sits on its board, and this app never guesses a name.
ok-conservation-district-directors.wanted: A list of each district's five current directors, published by the Oklahoma Conservation Commission or by each district.

ok-judicial-district-judges.summary: Your Judicial District card says which district you are in and which counties elect each of its district judges, and names none of the judges yet.
ok-judicial-district-judges.why: The only list read so far is the State Election Board's roster from March 2025, which may be out of date, and the court system's own website asks automated readers to stay away.
ok-judicial-district-judges.wanted: A current list of each district's judges that this project may read, or the State Election Board's next roster.

ok-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app names the mayor and council of Oklahoma's 16 cities above 25,000 people, and not those of its 584 smaller cities and towns.
ok-municipal-officeholders.why: No state office publishes who holds Oklahoma's city offices or where their wards run, so each of the 16 is read from its own pages, and the wards of ten from each city's own map.
ok-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide list of every city's and town's mayor, council members and trustees, kept current, saying which seats each ward elects and which the whole city elects, and a statewide map of city wards.

ok-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people elected to run it.
ok-school-board-members.why: Oklahoma's school boards are elected, and no statewide list of their members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
ok-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.

ok-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the nation, or nations, whose Census area you clicked on, with each one's seat and website. It does not name any nation's council yet.
ok-tribal-government.why: Each nation publishes its own government on its own site, and this app has not read any Oklahoma nation's council list yet.
ok-tribal-government.wanted: Each nation's own published list of its council, and its district map where it elects by district.
